notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one letter until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Write the familiar ਪ once. The new base begins similarly but is not the same letter.
Trace ਫ slowly twice. This is pha. Stop before adding any dot or vowel mark.
Cover the model, write ਫ (pha) once, then compare only its shape.
One new base is enough.

segments.prompt: Write the new Gurmukhi base letter pha.

feedback.correct: ਫ is the new base shape.
feedback.incorrect: Trace ਫ once more, without adding a dot.

lessons.title: ਫ਼ (fa) — place one dot below
lessons.gloss: add the below-letter dot that changes pha to fa

notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one mark until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Write ਫ (pha) once and leave room directly below it.
Add the small dot below: ਫ + ਼ = ਫ਼. This below-letter dot is pairin bindi; here it changes pha to the borrowed sound fa. It is not the above-letter bindi already used in ਹਾਂ.
Copy ਫ਼ (fa) once. Point to the dot below before you stop.
Only the base and its below-letter dot are scored here.

segments.prompt: Add the below-letter dot to ਫ (pha) and write the result.

feedback.correct: ਫ਼ carries the borrowed f sound.
feedback.incorrect: Keep the dot below the base: ਫ਼.

lessons.title: ੋ (hora) — add the long-o mark
lessons.gloss: trace and place the Gurmukhi long-o vowel mark

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one vowel mark until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Write ਫ਼ (fa) once.
The vowel mark ੋ, called hora, sits above and to the right of its base. Add it to the known base: ਫ਼ (fa) + ੋ = ਫ਼ੋ.
Copy ਫ਼ੋ once. Check that the dot stays below and hora stays above-right.
Stop after this one vowel mark.

segments.prompt: Add hora to ਫ਼ (fa) and write the result.

feedback.incorrect: Keep the dot below and place ੋ above-right: ਫ਼ੋ.

segments.text: Touch the pieces in order: ਫ (pha), the dot below, ੋ (hora), ਨ.
Join the pieces as ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon). On this fictional beginner form, ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon) labels the phone-number line. Copy the label once and leave its value blank.
Point to ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon) and say what information belongs there. Do not add digits.
No real contact information is requested.

segments.prompt: A fictional practice form shows ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon). What belongs on that line?

feedback.incorrect: ਫ਼ੋਨ labels a phone number on this practice form.

segments.text: Write the three known Gurmukhi digits: ੧, ੨, ੫.
Trace ੦ twice. It is the Gurmukhi digit zero. Phone values are identifiers, so a leading zero stays visible.
Cover the model and write ੦ (zero) once.
All four digit shapes needed by this chapter are now known.

segments.prompt: Write the Gurmukhi digit for zero.

notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — six places until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Point to the digits as they are named: zero, one, two, five.

Fictional practice value A is ੦੧੨੨੫੧ (zero-one-two-two-five-one). Touch and say each place from left to right: ੦, ੧, ੨, ੨, ੫, ੧. This short value is only curriculum data; it is not a real or callable number.
Copy A once, pausing after the third digit. Do not add grouping yet.
Only one six-place value is active.

segments.prompt: Copy fictional practice phone value A digit by digit.

feedback.correct: A keeps all six digits in order.
feedback.incorrect: Touch the six places left to right and copy only the first mismatch again.

segments.text: Touch value A, ੦੧੨੨੫੧ (zero-one-two-two-five-one), from left to right once.
Fictional practice value B is ੦੨੫੧੨੫ (zero-two-five-one-two-five). Touch each place: ੦, ੨, ੫, ੧, ੨, ੫. It uses only the four introduced digit shapes.
Copy B once, pausing after the third digit. Do not add grouping yet.
The bounded bank now contains exactly A and B.

segments.prompt: Copy fictional practice phone value B digit by digit.

feedback.correct: B keeps all six digits in order.
feedback.incorrect: Touch the six places left to right and copy only the first mismatch again.

segments.text: Shuffle four cards marked ੦ (zero), ੧, ੨, ੫. Name each card before writing.

blocks.title: You'll want to know — locate, do not guess

segments.text: In A, circle the second digit. In B, circle the fifth digit. Read the complete values only after locating those positions.
Hear: zero, one, two, two, five, one. Write one digit after each word, then compare with A.
No unintroduced numeral is scored.

segments.prompt: Write these heard digits in order: zero, one, two, two, five, one.

feedback.correct: Each heard digit maps to one introduced Gurmukhi shape.
feedback.incorrect: Replay one digit at a time and repair only the first mismatch.

segments.text: Read the closed bank once: A ੦੧੨੨੫੧ (zero-one-two-two-five-one); B ੦੨੫੧੨੫ (zero-two-five-one-two-five).

blocks.title: You'll want to know — two fixed selectors

segments.text: For this fictional practice only, ਕ means A and ਖ means B. Point to the matching value before your pen moves. The selector is not part of the phone field.
For ਖ, select B. For ਕ, select A. Selection and digit writing are separate checks.
The selectors carry no special meaning outside this exercise.

segments.prompt: The fictional selector is ਖ. Select A or B, then give its known value.

feedback.correct: ਖ selects B in this bounded bank.
feedback.incorrect: Return to the fixed selector map: ਖ means B.

segments.text: Point to ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon). Read the visible bank: A ੦੧੨੨੫੧ (zero-one-two-two-five-one); B ੦੨੫੧੨੫ (zero-two-five-one-two-five).
The selector is ਕ. Complete ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon): __________ (phone field) with A while the bank remains visible. Write one digit per place.
Point under each copied digit and compare all six places left to right.
This supported copy does not earn independent-writing credit.

segments.prompt: With the bank visible, complete the fictional phone field for ਕ.

feedback.correct: The supported row uses A in six-place order.
feedback.incorrect: Select A first, then compare one digit at a time.

notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one grouping boundary until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Touch A in six places: ੦ (zero), ੧, ੨, ੨, ੫, ੧.

Insert one clear space after the third digit: ੦੧੨ ੨੫੧ (three digits, space, three digits) (heard digit string). The space helps the eye track the practice value; it does not remove or reorder a digit. B groups as ੦੨੫ ੧੨੫.
Copy grouped B once. Count three digits, make one space, then count three more.
This book keeps one grouping inside the bounded practice bank; it is not a claim about every real-world phone format.

segments.prompt: Rewrite fictional value A with its three-plus-three grouping.

feedback.correct: A keeps six digits with one middle space.
feedback.incorrect: Keep the order and place one space after digit three.

segments.text: Study ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon): ੦੨੫ ੧੨੫ (delayed phone-field entry) for five seconds. Say each digit while pointing.
Hide the bank. Wait five seconds. For ਖ, complete one blank ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon) field from memory.
Uncover the model only after writing. Compare digit selection, order, and the single group space separately.
The model is hidden during the attempt.

segments.prompt: After hiding the bank for five seconds, complete the fictional phone field for ਖ.

feedback.correct: B was recovered after a short delay.
feedback.incorrect: Finish the attempt, uncover B, and repair only the first mismatch.

segments.text: Without a number model, write the four introduced digits when you hear: zero, one, two, five.
Listen twice: zero — one — two | two — five — one. The pause marks the one group space. Write Gurmukhi digits; do not write English numerals or words.
Read your six digits back left to right. Check the space only after checking all six positions.
Romanization and Latin digits do not earn the Gurmukhi writing score.

segments.prompt: Write in Gurmukhi digits: zero, one, two; pause; two, five, one.

feedback.correct: The heard sequence became six Gurmukhi digits with one group space.
feedback.incorrect: Replay one digit at a time and repair only the first mismatch.

segments.text: Name four separate checks: cue selection, six digit positions, middle group space, and placement on the ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon) line.

For ਕ, inspect ਫ਼ੋਨ (fon): ੦੧੨੨ ੫੧. The selected value and digit order are right; only the group boundary is wrong. Repair it as ੦੧੨ ੨੫੧ (three digits, space, three digits) (heard digit string) without rewriting correct digits.
Run the checks in order. Stop after the first differing dimension is repaired.
Do not replace the whole answer when one dimension differs.

segments.prompt: For ਕ, repair only the grouping in ੦੧੨੨ ੫੧.

feedback.incorrect: Keep all six digits and move the space after digit three.

segments.text: Close the previous lessons. There is no value bank, support-language label, Latin-digit version, or copyable Gurmukhi answer below.

This closes only the untimed phone-field ladder. Date, integration, and A1 readiness remain separate dependency-linked work.

feedback.correct: The selector independently selected the grouped Gurmukhi value B.
